title: A leak-reduction frontier under a falling cost ceiling
heading: Jump Past Floors the Slack Already Covers, and Stop at the First Infeasible One
cases: every plan of the frontier is returned, highest cost ceiling first
a sweep whose last ceiling is the lowest cost asks the model once per plan
a ceiling no plan meets is asked once and ends the sweep
with a step of 5 the jump moves by whole steps and still finds every plan
a top ceiling of 203 with a step of 5: the jump still counts whole steps and misses no plan
